content: Vercel serverless functions (plain Node.js runtime, non-Next.js) auto-parse request bodies by default, which breaks Stripe signature verification (needs raw untouched body). Fix: read raw body manually from the Node IncomingMessage stream (collect 'data'/'end' events into a Buffer) before any parsing, or use the modern Web API handler style (export default function(request){ await request.text() }) which gives raw text directly. Do this only on the webhook route.
